name: nova-contract
description: NØVA Compact contract — private credential commitments and proof attestations on Midnight

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && cp -Rf ./src/managed ./dist/managed && cp ./src/nova.compact ./dist
scripts.compact: command -v compact >/dev/null 2>&1 && compact compile src/nova.compact ./src/managed/nova || echo 'Skipping compact compilation (using pre-compiled artifacts in src/managed)'
